columns.name: ad_group_criterion_criterion_id
columns.comment: The ID of the criterion. This field is ignored for mutates.

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: ad_group_base_ad_group
columns.comment: For draft or experiment ad groups, this field is the resource name of the base ad group from which this ad group was created. If a draft or experiment ad group does not have a base ad group, then this field is null. For base ad groups, this field equals the ad group resource name. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_base_campaign
columns.comment: The resource name of the base campaign of a draft or experiment campaign. For base campaigns, this is equal to `resource_name`. This field is read-only.

columns.name: metrics_active_view_impressions
columns.comment: A measurement of how often your ad has become viewable on a Display Network site.

columns.name: metrics_active_view_measurability
columns.comment: The ratio of impressions that could be measured by Active View over the number of served impressions.

columns.name: metrics_active_view_measurable_cost_micros
columns.comment: The cost of the impressions you received that were measurable by Active View.

columns.name: metrics_active_view_measurable_impressions
columns.comment: The number of times your ads are appearing on placements in positions where they can be seen.

columns.name: metrics_active_view_viewability
columns.comment: The percentage of time when your ad appeared on an Active View enabled site (measurable impressions) and was viewable (viewable impressions).

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions_value
columns.comment: The total value of all conversions.

columns.name: metrics_clicks
columns.comment: The number of clicks.

columns.name: metrics_conversions
columns.comment: The number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_conversions_value
columns.comment: The total value of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_cost_micros
columns.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period.

columns.name: metrics_cross_device_conversions
columns.comment: Conversions from when a customer clicks on a Google Ads ad on one device, then converts on a different device or browser. Cross-device conversions are already included in all_conversions.

columns.name: metrics_impressions
columns.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

columns.name: metrics_interaction_event_types
columns.comment: The types of payable and free interactions.

columns.name: metrics_interactions
columns.comment: The number of interactions. An interaction is the main user action associated with an ad format-clicks for text and shopping ads, views for video ads, and so on.

columns.name: metrics_view_through_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of view-through conversions. These happen when a customer sees an image or rich media ad, then later completes a conversion on your site without interacting with (e.g., clicking on) another ad.

columns.name: segments_ad_network_type
columns.comment: Ad network type.

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.

columns.name: segments_device
columns.comment: Device to which metrics apply.
